posts.title: Let’s Encrypt on an HP LaserJet M553, renewed from a Proxmox container
posts.description: HP LaserJet Enterprise printers ship with a self-signed certificate and no ACME client. Mine now serves a Let’s Encrypt certificate on its admin page and on IPPS/AirPrint, and a small Alpine container on Proxmox renews it every two months without me touching the printer. Here is how.
